description:
One cached generation used as a CI fixture.

Required logical fields: question_id, config_id, model, prompt_hash,
answer, cited ids, abstained. Legacy MVP fixtures omit config_id /
prompt_hash / cited_ids — validators fill defaults from existing keys.

config_id.description: Eval config id, e.g. chunk_500 or hybrid+rerank
config_id.title: Config Id

prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the exact prompt; empty for legacy fixtures
prompt_hash.title: Prompt Hash

cited_ids.description: Cited article numbers (display ids) or LEGIARTI ids
cited_ids.title: Cited Ids

title: GenerationRecord
